lawyer: No one appears of both sides.
parties:
Shahajahan Chowdhury and Others
v.
Rustom Ali
full_judgment: 5. The defendant Nos. 2, 5-9 contested the suit by filing written statement denied the material allegations as stated in the plaint. The case of defendant No. 5 is that the plaintiff and defendants Nos. 1-4 and. the defendant No. 5 father of the defendant Nos. 6-9 are brothers and are members of joint family. The plaintiff and defendant No. 5 jointly run the business in Chittagong and defendant Nos. 1-3 reside in the village home and looked after the affairs of joint family. The defendant No. 4 resides outside of the country. The plaintiff and defendant No. 5 for searching the job came to Chittagong in the year 1945 and they failed to manage the job. They had started a business of making wood box and subsequently in the year 1952 they established a joint business firm name "Rustom Ali and Brothers." As elder brother the plaintiff was given responsibility to look after the village home. The defendant No. 5 sent money to the plaintiff to purchase Rods Cement and other materials. The plaintiff as elder brother purchased about 60 acres of land in the name of plaintiff and defendant Nos. 1-5, constructed Pucca house by their own money. Constructed mosque and Madrasha and spent Tk. 15,600/- for purchase Honda for the husband of plaintiffs eldest Daughter and gave education and marriage to the sons and daughters from the income of Chittagong business. The defendant No. 5 can show the Accounts. The plaintiff after 1958-1982 used to reside in the village home and elected as a member and Chairman of Union Parishad and as such it was not possible for him to look after the business. The plaintiff only came to Chittagong town for 2/3 days and return back home after taking money from the income of business. In the election of plaintiff about Taka 100,000/- was spent from business and when he was in jail in the year 1982 for Mis-appropriation of rice about Taka 50,000/- was spent in case connection from business fund. The cash of the business always remained with the defendant No. 5. The defendant No. 5 took lease of land from Bangladesh Railway in the name of Rustom Ali and brothers. The plaintiff and defendant Nos. 1-5 purchased 5 Trucks separately and jointly in their own name and in the name of their mother and plaintiff's wife. Out of 5 Trucks the plaintiff looked after the 2 Trucks which was in the name of his wife and mother and other 3 Truck was looked after by the defendant No. 5. The plaintiff and defendant No. 5 in the year 1977 established a firm Jewel transport in the name of his son and took telephone line in the year 1978 in the name of Rustom Ali and Brothers for easier communication. The defendant No. 5 had been residing permanently in the year 1972 in Chittagong with his son and daughters and was admitted them in School and College. In the year 1978 the plaintiff and defendant No. 5 took decision to purchase land in Chittagong Town for permanent residence and also took decision they will purchase 211 gandas of land in the name of plaintiff and 211 gandas of land in the name of defendant Nos. 5 and 4 gandas in the name of defendant Nos. 1, 2, 3, 4. The defendant No. 5 has given all expenses for purchase the land from business fund. After registration of the document when the defendant No. 5 went to the Tahasil Office to pay rent they told that they will take the rent after mutation. The defendant No. 5 when wanted the deed for mutation from the plaintiff, the plaintiff was given him all the documents and found from the documents the plaintiff purchased the land in the name of two sons, wife and mother violating the decision instead of purchase the 4 gandas in the name of defendant Nos.1-4. The plaintiff purchased 1 ganda 2 karas in the name of defendant Nos.1-4. The plaintiff intentionally created those documents. The defendant No. 5 without going any quarrel with the elder brother mutated B.S. Khatian in the name of 14 persons. The plaintiff and defendant No. 5 were jointly possessed the Schedule land through bharatia. The plaintiff was given charge to look after the property and developed the property. The plaintiff used to collect the rent and the plaintiff when became Chairman and in jail the defendant No. 5 used to collect rent and paid Municipal Tax. The defendant No. 5 in the year 1992 when decided to construct house and requested the plaintiff to replace the tenant and demarcated the boundary. The plaintiff ensured that he would do it and afterwards killing time today and tomorrow. There is a salish held in that matter. The plaintiff took away all the Registered documents and other necessary papers from Almira of the business office. The defendant Nos. 2 and 4 gifted their purchased 3 karas of land in favour of the defendant No.5 by registered deed dated 24.04.1993. The plaintiff in order to grab the suit land filed this false suit as such the suit is liable to be dismissed with cost.
